# QXL201: channel="ibm_quantum" is removed in qiskit-ibm-runtime 0.41

- **Name**: `removed-ibm-quantum-channel`
- **Tier**: default
- **Severity**: error
- **Version gated**: yes

## Why this is a problem

The "ibm_quantum" channel was deprecated in qiskit-ibm-runtime 0.40.0 and removed in 0.41.0 with the sunset of IBM Quantum Platform Classic. Verified on qiskit-ibm-runtime 0.49.0: QiskitRuntimeService raises ValueError during construction, and QiskitRuntimeService.save_account raises InvalidAccountError, so both call sites are checked. Both "ibm_cloud" and "ibm_quantum_platform" point at the same API, "ibm_quantum_platform" is the default, and the argument can be omitted entirely.

## When this is legitimate

On a project pinned below qiskit-ibm-runtime 0.41 the value still works, so the rule downgrades to a deprecation notice there and says nothing at all when the target version cannot be established. A project that cannot prove its target version never sees this rule.

## Flagged

```python
from qiskit_ibm_runtime import QiskitRuntimeService

service = QiskitRuntimeService(channel="ibm_quantum", token=TOKEN)
```

## Not flagged

```python
from qiskit_ibm_runtime import QiskitRuntimeService

service = QiskitRuntimeService(token=TOKEN)
```

## Suppressing

```python
result = compute()  # noqa: QXL201
```

```toml
[tool.qxlint]
ignore = ["QXL201"]
```
